decision.explanation: Both awards are directly supported by the original sources. D1S1–D1S10 and D1S15 confirm Heidemaria Gürer received the Knight of the Legion of Honour from the French government. D2S4, D2S5, and D2S6 explicitly state she received the Grand Cross of the Order of Orange-Nassau. These are distinct awards from separate countries (France and the Netherlands) and are both clearly attributed to her in the provided texts.
